engine.notes: Two companies carry the scene: The Bird, a purpose-built Crossroads theater with a weekly jam, and the KC Improv Company, 26 years old and back in Westport on Thursdays. Overland Park has no improv venue of its own; Clint's Comedy Club runs a stand-up open mic there, and Improv Springboard (women and nonbinary improvisers) and Act Your Age Improv (adults 50+) announce workshops only on social medi

entries.name: The Bird Comedy Theater
entries.summary: A Crossroads comedy theater opened in 2022 with improv shows every Friday and Saturday, a free-to-play open improv jam on Thursdays and classes from drop-ins to sixteen-week advanced sessions.
entries.schedule: Thu Open Jam 7:30pm and Open Mic 9:30pm; Fri & Sat Improv Show 7:30pm and Comedy Show 9:30pm
signals: Opened 2022; voted KC's best comedy club
Intro to Improv eight weeks, Oct 20 - Dec 8, 2026 ($178 per the KCUR guide)
Long Form II and III Sundays Oct 18 - Dec 6, 2026
Free happy-hour drop-in improv classes Saturdays
Bird House showcase of three in-house groups every third Saturday
entries.reasons: Only four years old, but it has its own Crossroads room, a dated three-level curriculum, weekend improv shows and a weekly open jam.

entries.name: The KC Improv Company
entries.summary: Kansas City's longest-running improv company, performing since 2000, now playing Thursday nights at GreenHorn in Westport with eight-week Improv 101-301 classes at The Bowery and Thursday drop-ins in Waldo.
entries.schedule: Shows Thursdays 7pm at GreenHorn from Oct 1; drop-in classes Thursdays 7pm at KC Bier Co, Waldo
signals: Diversity scholarships cover about half of class fees
Student showcases on the company stage
Also runs five levels at Trinity Lutheran's Mission, KS campus
entries.reasons: A quarter century of weekly shows and a three-level ladder with scholarships, but it performs one night a week in a bar it does not own and the class page still shows June start dates.
